name: cip_nightly
description: Nightly pipeline. Each state calls a function that exists and is tested locally; the Circuit adds scheduling and retry, not logic.

ingest.comment: Consume NDJSON batches from Stratus into raw, then curated.

data_quality.comment: Run the DQ suite. A blocking failure stops the run rather than publishing untrustworthy gold tables.

halt.cause: One or more blocking data-quality checks failed. Curated data was not promoted.

intelligence.comment: Entity resolution, graph rebuild, embeddings, hotspots, early warning, priority scores.

retention.comment: Purge expired conversation state. Audit rows are never purged here.
